lines.trans: A bachelor's room like this really looks austere and empty.
Are you cold? Let me turn up the air conditioning for you.
No, do not get up—it is fine, really no need!
No need to be polite; if you feel chilly there is a blanket over there you can drape around your shoulders.
No need at all—I am not cold, I actually feel a bit warm.
Wait—my phone is not that brand.
Yes, I escaped from the hospital and was just about to contact you.
You are all right outside my front door? Alright, give me a moment.
Now this apartment really is getting hot—what am I supposed to do?
If the chairwoman discovers I am here at your flat, what will I do?
Here—go stay inside my bedroom for now.
